Departure of Chief Financial Officer On October 23, 2026, Matt Ofilos, the Chief Financial Officer (“CFO”) of Parsons Corporation (the “Corporation”), notified the Corporation of his decision to resign from his position as Chief Financial Officer, effective November 6, 2026, to pursue another professional opportunity. Mr. Ofilos’ resignation is not the result of any disagreement with the Corporation on any matter relating to the Corporation’s operations, policies or practices. Appointment of Interim Chief Financial Officer On October 26, 2026, the Corporation’s board of directors appointed George Ball as the Corporation’s Interim CFO, effective November 6, 2026. Mr. Ball will continue to serve as a member of the board of directors following his appointment as Interim CFO. Mr. Ball joined the Corporation’s board of directors in 2022 following his tenure as the Corporation’s CFO from 2008 to 2022. Biographical information regarding Mr. Ball is set forth in the Corporation’s 2026 proxy statement filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on March 2, 2026, and such information is incorporated by reference herein. Mr. Ball does not serve on any of the committees of the board of directors of the Corporation. As consideration for his service as Interim CFO, Mr. Ball will receive a $2,400,000 award of restricted stock units (“RSUs”) that will vest on the one-year anniversary of the award, with the final number of vested RSUs subject to pro-ration based on Mr. Ball’s actual service period as Interim CFO during the one-year vesting period. While serving as Interim CFO, Mr. Ball will continue to serve as a member of the board of directors but will not receive any additional cash or equity compensation for such service. A copy of the Corporation’s press release regarding the CFO transition and the appointment of Mr. Ball as the Corporation’s Interim CFO is being furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K.
